skill_name: Identify and outline the various phases of the moon.
workflow: The phases of the moon occur as it orbits the Earth and is illuminated by the Sun. The phases are: New Moon, Waxing Crescent, First Quarter, Waxing Gibbous, Full Moon, Waning Gibbous, Third Quarter, and Waning Crescent. The New Moon is when the Moon is completely dark and cannot be seen. The Waxing Crescent is when the Moon is partially illuminated and only a small portion is visible.
